title: Played a short AI game where lying makes your nose grow
author: India_Gallagher
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/5vnkdjvsbtxh1.gif

The controls are simple: WASD for movement; Shift opens the run; E for the talking; and 1 or 2 for choosing answers. The game menu is as follows: Geppetto's store → go ahead and lie → Tuscans via the chase around the city with the Carabinieri.

The character's nose is created using the Blender shape key formula so there are no bones involved, and the long nose is kept well into the new territory. Hence you have the game state kept simply between scenes without losing its effect. As far as the AI generated game is concerned, this is the feature that has made a considerable impression on me.  

The only negative side of the game that I have seen is that it is too short.  

If you have any ideas for improvements, I can certainly implement them.
